name: Ľudovít Ódor - Projet du Conseil
title: REPORT on the draft Council directive amending Directive 2006/112/EC as regards VAT rules for the digital age
part_text:
The European Parliament has approved the Council's updated plan to modernise value added tax (VAT) rules for the digital age. The plan makes online platforms responsible for collecting VAT on sales they host, but this starts voluntarily in July 2028 and becomes mandatory in January 2030. Small and medium-sized businesses can be exempted. Countries can keep their own invoicing systems, and deadlines are longer than originally proposed. Parliament did not request any changes.

- **What changes:** Online platforms become responsible for collecting VAT on hosted sales; small businesses can be exempted.
- **Who it affects:** Online platforms, small and medium-sized businesses, and tax authorities in European Union countries.
- **What happens next:** Countries must adopt the rules; Parliament is asked to be consulted again if the text changes substantially.
